text: Across from the wooded lawn of the Eliot Art School, this Jamaica Plain single-family offers a view that changes with every season. Inlaid floors, original windows, and a front door with sidelights carry the home's history forward. Bay windows brighten the living room, a formal dining room invites hosting, and a back family room awaits insulation to become a year-round space. Upstairs are two bedrooms, two full baths, a flex space, and two finished attic rooms for a studio, office, or guests. A separate entrance leads to a bedroom, bath, flex space, and kitchenette, offering options for extended family or independent living. The roof, windows, and exterior stairs need work, giving a buyer the chance to invest in a home whose character and location can't be replicated. The home is close to Centre Street's shops and restaurants, Jamaica Pond, the Arnold Arboretum and everything JP has to offer. Homes like this, in this location, don't come around often!

Welcome to 23 Belle Ave here in WR! This single-family residence represents a classic architectural opportunity. Constructed in 1960, the home offers 1,148 square feet of living space, providing a foundational layout that serves as an excellent canvas for personal expression. The residence encompasses three bedrooms, offering versatile space that can be adapted to accommodate a home office, a library, or personal living quarters depending on individual requirements. The home is supported by one full bathroom, designed to provide essential functionality for the household. A 8,415-square-foot lot has many choices for investors. Further, offering significant outdoor potential rarely found within the city, while the classic 1960 construction provides a base for those looking to establish their presence in a meaningful location. We invite you to schedule a private viewing to experience the potential of this property firsthand and envision how it can serve your unique lifestyle needs.

This four-bedroom home needs work but has so much potential to restore. A charming 1931 Colonial on an 11,411 sq ft lot in sought-after West Roxbury with high ceilings, detailed moldings, hardwood floors, and a fireplace. The roof and gutters have been updated. The generous yard has room to expand and space to enjoy. A large basement with a walkout to the yard and off-street parking for four add everyday convenience. Enjoy easy access to the VFW Parkway, a convenient commute to downtown Boston, and close proximity to the commuter rail in downtown West Roxbury. This is one of those special homes with really good bones to work with. The structure has withstood the test of time, and this is one you will make your own for years to come.

Welcome Home! Built in 1926, this lovingly cared for home offers timeless character, solid construction, and wonderful potential for its next chapter. Full of yesteryear charm, this home features, hardwood floors, high ceilings, welcoming living room with fireplace, dedicated office area, and a dining room with charming built-in. The spacious kitchen offers plenty of room to make it your own! Upstairs, the main bedroom features a walk-in closet, along with two generously sized bedrooms. Enjoy the enclosed porch, perfect for relaxing or step out onto the rear deck overlooking the level, fenced yard. A one-car garage adds convenience, while the peaceful neighborhood and highly convenient location make this home an especially appealing find with easy access to train, bus etc. Ready for thoughtful updating to suit todays tastes, this solid character filled home is a wonderful opportunity to bring your vision to life while preserving the classic appealOffer deadline -Tuesday Oct 27th before Noon

OPEN HOUSE SUN 11/8. Rare opportunity in one of West Roxbury's most sought-after neighborhoods, where homes on this desirable cul-de-sac seldom come to market! This charming 3-4 bedroom Cape blends classic character with exceptional versatility. Gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout, while a cozy gas fireplace creates the perfect gathering spot in the living room. A first-floor bedroom offers flexibility for guests, a home office, or one-level living. The full finished basement is a standout feature, offering incredible potential for an ADU, complete with an existing full bathroom and kitchenette. Step outside to a spacious deck overlooking a private backyard-ideal for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying warm summer evenings. Welcome to this charming 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Colonial, ideally located in a desirable neighborhood close to shops, schools, parks, and transportation. The spacious eat-in kitchen features a center island and offers plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. The home also includes a formal living room, dining room with wainscoting and a lovely bow window, fireplaced family room, and dedicated home office. The finished lower level provides additional flexible living space. A deck offers a pleasant spot for outdoor dining and relaxing, while the 2-car garage provides added convenience.

Welcome to this charming Cape, nestled on one of the cutest streets in town! Step inside this bright and airy home, where a comfortable and flowing floor plan welcomes you.The spacious living room features a large picture window that fills the space with natural light, a beautiful wood-burning fireplace with dentil moulding, and hardwood floors that continue throughout the home. The living room opens to a versatile adjoining space that can be used as a cozy sitting area, home office, playroom, or whatever best suits your needs.The beautifully updated kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a large breakfast bar with plenty of seating. A dedicated dining area provides the perfect setting for everyday meals or entertaining guests.There is also plenty of potential for future expansion! The lower level features a large, open basement with direct walkout access to the patio and backyard. Some updates include roof and gutters 2018 and boiler 2023. Outside, enjoy a lovely fenced-in yard with mature plantings and a convenient storage shed.Ideally located near major highways, restaurants, shops, public transportation, the VA Hospital, and more, this home offers both charm and convenience. Come see all that this wonderful property has to offer-you won't want to miss it!

Beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home. Full gut renovation w/ everything new throughout. The first floor features an open-concept layout w/ a custom kitchen, two-tone cabinetry, stone countertops and backsplash, stainless steel appliances, large dining area, and spacious living room with direct access to an expansive 180-degree rear deck. The second floor offers four generously sized bedrooms, including a large primary suite w/ tall ceilings, walk-in closet, and private spa-like bath w/ double vanity, oversized tiled shower, and freestanding soaking tub. Second-floor laundry for added convenience. The fully finished basement includes a full bathroom, theater/media room, and additional flexible space for a gym, office, playroom, or guest area. Everything has been updated from top to bottom, including a new roof, siding, windows, electrical, plumbing, mechanicals, central heat and AC, and spray-foam insulation. Hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, attached garage, driveway parking, and a fenced corner lot complete the property. This home offers the space and finishes of a new home without giving up the character and convenience of an established West Roxbury neighborhood. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, public transportation, commuter rail, and major routes. Completely finished, move-in ready, and designed for both everyday living and entertaining.

Premium Transformation on Woodley Ave, Nothing To Do but Move In! Fully renovated 3BR/2BA on a quiet West Roxbury private way. All-new systems, windows, floors, finishes and a beautifully transformed backyard. Brand-new kitchen with quartz counters, full-height quartz backsplash, maple cabinets, under-cabinet lighting, stainless steel appliances, outdoor-venting hybrid microwave/convection oven. Off the kitchen, a sunlit room that opens to the backyard - ideal as lounge, home office or guest entertaining area. Two floor-to-ceiling tiled full baths with built-in storage closets: one with a deep steel soaking tub, one with a wall-to-wall walk-in shower and glass door. New 4" white oak hardwood throughout with premium protective finish. Brand-new windows, mostly triple-pane for energy efficiency, incl. a large bay and 2 architectural windows that flood the home with natural light. Mineral wool soundproofing in all bath walls and the ceiling between basement and 1st floor, acoustic rubber underlayment between 1st and 2nd floors, 1.75" solid-core interior doors throughout. All-new major systems: Bosch 2-zone heat pump (central A/C and heating) with gas furnace backup, 80-gal Wi-Fi heat pump water heater w/ leak detection, Wi-Fi Bosch HVAC controls. A 200amp Leviton smart-ready electrical panel with whole-home surge protection, pre-wired with two dedicated electrical circuits for additional appliances, AFCI/GFCI on most circuits and EV-charger pre-wire. Newly finished basement: 2 versatile rooms you can use as additional bedrooms, office, gym, media, playroom or recreation spaces, mechanical room with a stainless steel sink and storage area, additional closet and a dedicated laundry room with gas and electric laundry hookups. Freshly reimagined backyard built for summer nights and slow gardening mornings. CertainTeed roof (2022) with transferable warranty. Granite front and rear stairs, Techo-Bloc patio and walkways, custom landscape lighting, updated and powered shed, refreshed landscaping, newly paved driveway and parking for 3+ cars. Ring doorbell and cameras. On the bus line, close to commuter rail, major highways, Centre Street shops and restaurants, Dedham Mall, Legacy Place & Longwood Medical Area. Boston residential exemption reduces property taxes by $4,354 for qualified owner occupants.

Tucked away on a private road, this beautifully maintained single-family residence offers a warm and inviting atmosphere from the moment you arrive. The open-concept living and dining spaces flow effortlessly together, creating the perfect setting for cozy evenings at home or entertaining family and friends. The heart of the home is the gorgeous gourmet kitchen, featuring elegant stone countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and a spacious peninsula that naturally invites conversation, casual meals, and memorable gatherings. The rear deck and patio overlooks a versatile backyard, offering plenty of room to relax, garden, entertain, or simply enjoy your own private outdoor retreat.Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms, a beautifully updated full bathroom, and a charming home office-perfect for remote work, reading, or a quiet creative space. The updated bathrooms feature imported tile, contemporary vanities, and a stylish walk-in shower.Modern conveniences include central A/C, a modern heat pump, in-unit washer and dryer, off-street parking, and a full walkout basement offering abundant storage and exciting potential for future use.Ideally situated near major highways, shopping, restaurants, and everyday amenities, this home offers a peaceful private setting without giving up convenience. With its inviting spaces, timeless details, modern updates, and wonderful outdoor areas, this is more than a house-it's a place to feel at home.

Situated at 28 Heathcote St in Boston's Roslindale neighborhood, this single-family colonial is distinguished by its cheerful exterior, southeast-facing corner location, classic New England charm, and 2021 rebuild. Originally a traditional Cape, this three-bedroom, two-bath residence underwent a remarkable transformation, emerging as a full two-story home that offers the character of an established neighborhood with the comfort and appeal of modern updates. Inside, you'll find a classic layout with full-height second-floor ceilings and nearly new solid oak flooring throughout. A first-floor bedroom and full bath offer added flexibility and convenience, while two spacious second-floor bedrooms each extend the full length of the home. The roof, solar and heating system, all approximately five years old, offer added peace of mind and greater predictability in future homeownership costs. A freshly painted rear deck provides an inviting space for outdoor relaxation, and the driveway off Hawthorne Street and detached one-car garage offer the welcome convenience of off-street parking. The full, unfinished walkout basement provides storage or your future lower-level finished bonus space. Nestled in a walkable neighborhood, this property is just blocks from the vibrant heart of Roslindale Village. Explore its restaurants, shops, and beloved farmers market at Adams Park, and enjoy nearby Fallon Field, Healy Playground, and the Arnold Arboretum. Commuters will value the nearby MBTA Roslindale Village Station and a myriad of bus lines,. Blending classic New England character with modern improvements, convenient parking, and exceptional access to amenities and transportation, 28 Heathcote Street offers a distinctive opportunity to enjoy Boston living. We invite you to schedule a private viewing or attend an Open House to experience this residence firsthand. Several rooms have been virtually staged. Pedestrians, vehicles and adjacent homes may have been blurred to protect neighbors' privacy. See Seller's property disclosure for re-build details.

Welcome home to 37 Cedrus, a sun-filled top-floor condo with beautiful Boston skyline views and plenty of space to live comfortably. Step through the door and into a warm, light-filled interior where hardwood floors, natural wood trim, and an easy open flow make the home feel inviting from the start. Imagine starting the morning with coffee on the balcony as the Boston skyline stretches out beyond you, then coming back inside to a welcoming living room, with the decorative fireplace adding character to the space. The dining room is ready for Sunday dinners, holiday gatherings, and nights when friends stay a little longer, with custom built-ins adding both character and function. At the heart of it all, the generous kitchen gives you plenty of room to cook, gather, and be part of the conversation. When the day winds down, three comfortable bedrooms give everyone a place of their own, including a main bedroom with a private full bath. Need more room? The exclusive use 1,400+ sq ft walk-up attic offers storage and possible expansion, along with a small basement storage area. Outside, enjoy a second porch and common yard, while one deeded garage space, plus one tandem parking space in driveway, make coming home easy. With recent updates to the facade, porches, HVAC, retaining wall, washer, dryer, and microwave, the big work has already been addressed. And with Roslindale center close by, everyday conveniences are never far away. Ready for its new owners and offering the space, views, and location buyers are looking for. Don't miss your chance to see it in person! This is a condo. It feels like an attached SF, and the informal association functions like one.

Boston built very few late Victorian era Craftsman houses, and fewer still kept their interiors intact. This one did!! Behind an enclosed porch on Doctor's Row, a second door opens to a paneled Arts and Crafts hall with original casement windows, a window seat, and hand-blocked Sanderson Morris paper. It's something to behold. Beyond it, gumwood beams run the length of the living and dining rooms over high wood paneling. A plate rail on carved brackets carries the full wall, with the mantel set just below it and a firebox in patterned brick tile. Dividing the two rooms is a colonnade screen: one broad arched opening flanked by a pair of smaller blind arches on heavy posts. These details are unforgettable. Two glass-front china cabinets are built into the dining room. The woodwork was never painted over. Oak runs underfoot through the main rooms and gives way to mahogany flooring in the kitchen, where a large marble slab counter once served a working chef. Soft and warm red fir runs through the second floor. Afternoon light fills the living room, and an enclosed sun porch off the dining room stays bright through the day, a personal favorite of the current owners. The first floor loops: hall to living to dining to kitchen and back again, with a front office (originally a dentist office) and a half bath off the run. Upstairs, 4 bedrooms include a primary suite with walk-in closet and renovated bath in herringbone and marble, plus a bedroom now used as a den with a bow window and window seat. The finished walk-up third floor adds dormers, AC, a skylight, and room to spread out. Recent work covers the 2026 rear deck, exterior paint, repointed chimney, and cleaned flue, with a high-efficiency gas boiler from 2020. Fenced yard, garage/storage bay under the house, generous on-street pkg, and a corner lot that takes light on 3 sides. Roslindale Village, Fallon Field, the Arboretum, Roches Brothers/Centre Street, and the Bellevue commuter rail stop are all close by. This home represents a rare find for the buyer who appreciates a vintage home like this. First come, first serve!

Location, Location! This well maintained 3 bedroom 1.5 bath home is conveniently located off Belgrade Avenue, and is a short walk to the Belgrade Train Station and Roslindale Village. This home offers great natural light, beautiful hardwood floors throughout, large bedrooms, a large back yard and parking. The furnace has been replaced and the exterior has been upgraded to new fiber cement siding. Come take a look!

A bright, beautiful 3-bedroom Colonial single-family home with classic character, welcoming living spaces, two porches, and thoughtful updates that make this Roslindale home easy to settle into. Enter through the enclosed front porch into the foyer, where the home opens naturally into a comfortable first-floor layout. The living room draws you in with hardwood floors and a charming bay window that brings in plenty of natural light. From there, hardwood continues into the spacious dining room, creating an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers a practical setup with cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a full complement of appliances, along with a small dining area. A convenient mudroom connects the kitchen to the rear porch and composite deck, creating an easy transition from indoor living to outdoor space. Upstairs, three bedrooms offer room to spread out. The main bedroom features hardwood flooring, a double closet, custom built-in storage, and additional storage above the closet. The other bedrooms also feature hardwood floors and closets, with the third bedroom offering the flexibility to function as a bedroom, office, or whatever best suits your needs. The full bathroom features a heated tile floor for added comfort. The fenced backyard and rear deck offer a welcoming spot for morning coffee, gardening, summer dinners, or simply enjoying your own outdoor space. A full unfinished basement provides additional storage and utility space. The home has benefited from meaningful improvements, including a new Viessmann Vitodens heating and hot water system installed in 2025, foundation and sidewalk work, a brick walkway, exterior painting, fencing improvements, and ongoing roof maintenance. The roof has also received regular inspections and maintenance, with the most recent annual check completed in September 2026. With Roslindale Village just a short walk away, this home brings together the character, comfort, and everyday convenience that make a home feel special. Opportunities like this don't come along often.

Welcome to this charming single family brick in the heart of Roslindale. This turn key home is beautifully laid out with a lovely fireplace and mantle in your living room, large eat in kitchen with enough room for a table to dine, a separate dining room for hosting and two large bedrooms upstairs. There is a first floor bathroom and a fenced in yard off of the kitchen with a nice porch and bonus nook for relaxing while you grill and enjoy your backyard. The basement has a fireplace and has so much potential for a play room, home office, gym or whatever your heart desires. Dead end street and easy access to commuter rail, forest hills, highways, Pete Hill, the Arboretum, Longwood, Fenway and everything the city has to offer. Spend your weekends strolling to the seasonal farmer's market or dining in Roslindale Village. There are so many restaurants, bars and breweries to chose from. You don't' want to miss this one! It is a true GEM!

Charming, unique home with a freestanding accessory studio on a quiet street in desirable Roslindale. The first floor has front-to-back living and dining areas and a skylit kitchen with original glass-front cabinets, along with hardwood floors and 9' ceilings. A full bath completes the first floor. Upstairs provides two bedrooms, including a primary with built-in bookshelves, a deep closet and a convenient half bath. The full basement offers laundry and additional storage. The home is all-electric, with heat pumps for heat and cooling and owned solar panels. The outdoor area offers a brick patio, a nice manageable garden and driveway parking for three.The standout feature is the detached studio, ideal as a home office, or recreational space. It has its own seperate heat pump, a half bath and a kitchenette sink. Studio also offers a workroom underneath with separate entrance, attic storage and secluded patio. Just minutes to vibrant Roslindale Village with its much loved Farmers Market, shopping and restaurants, the commuter rail and the Arnold Arboretum. A truly special place to call home.

OPEN HOUSE SAT 11/21 - 12 - 1 pm. This unique single family has character, charm and warmth, with beautiful period details. Upstairs, you'll find a large primary bedroom with its own private deck, two more bedrooms and a full bath with separate laundry area. The finished basement, with a full bath and walkout entrance, and the bonus loft room on the 3rd floor can be used as you wish. The fenced yard is a gardeners' paradise, with raised beds and perennials. So near to vibrant Rozzie Village and its community spirit, where you'll find local shops, dining, the legendary Farmers' Market in Adams Park, the commuter rail and buses. Close to the Arboretum.

***PRICE IMPROVEMENT***Just outside West Roxbury's vibrant center sits this stately federal-style colonial, built in the early 1900s and full of character, charm and potential. Situated on a nearly 10,000-square-foot lot in a residential-two-family zoned neighborhood, this home offers just shy of 2,000 square feet of living area, including three bedrooms - two on the second level and one on the first level, one full and two half-baths, a spacious open area easily 'reimagined' as an eat-in kitchen and living space, and a beautiful living room featuring a carved wood mantle and flooded with natural light, plus a lower-level family room for additional living space. Freshly refinished hardwood floors and newly painted interior throughout bring it that much closer to move-in ready. An under-house garage and spacious driveway provide parking for six or more vehicles, plus a private rear yard. Location is unbeatable: on the bus line, a three-minute walk to the commuter rail, one minute stroll to Holy Name Parish, and a short drive to Faulkner Hospital and downtown Boston. The home was most recently used as a law office but can be returned back to residential use with City approval. This unique opportunity offers a wonderful opportunity to bring a piece of West Roxbury history back to life as a single-family home. Endless possibilities await!
